exampleCyrillic: Мој пријатељ живи у Новом Саду.
exampleTranslationEn: My friend lives in Novi Sad.

exampleCyrillic: Ја радим од јутра до вечери.
exampleTranslationEn: I work from morning to evening.
The doctor is in the hospital.
Our neighbor is a good man.
A big city has many people.
A beautiful day for a walk.
This day is a day off.

exampleTranslationRu: В среду я иду в школу.
В четверг мы едем в гости.
exampleTranslationEn: Thursday is a day for shopping.
Friday is the end of the week.
In the afternoon I'm going to the park.
The clock is on the wall.
Two hours is a long time.
Seven in the morning is early.

exampleCyrillic: Осам сати ујутру идем на посао.
exampleTranslationEn: I go to work at eight in the morning.
At nine I'm going to the cinema.
March is the first month of spring.
August is the month of rest.
